segments.name: Insurance Distribution
segments.description: Specialty P&C insurance underwriting and distribution business comprising MGAs, an insurance broker and related businesses serving specialty risk markets.
segments.evidence: Insurance Distribution — Octave's specialty property and casualty ("P&C") insurance underwriting and distribution business, includes Managing General Agents and Underwriters (collectively "MGAs" or "MGA/Us"); an insurance broker; and other distribution, underwriting and related businesses.

revenueModel.text: Insurance Distribution businesses earn commissions from insurance carriers for underwriting, structuring and administering policies, based on a percentage of premiums placed, plus profit-sharing contingent commissions.
revenueModel.evidence: ID's businesses are compensated for their services primarily by commissions paid by insurance carriers for underwriting, structuring and/or administering polices and, in some cases for managing claims under agency agreements.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company sold its Legacy Financial Guarantee business (Ambac Assurance Corporation) and rebranded from Ambac Financial Group to Octave Specialty Group.
changes.evidence: On September 29, 2025, the Company completed the sale of its Legacy Financial Guarantee business, inclusive of Ambac Assurance Corporation ("AAC") and its wholly owned subsidiary Ambac Assurance UK Limited ("AUK").

changes.text: In 2025, the Company acquired ArmadaCorp, a specialty accident and health MGA.
changes.evidence: On October 31, 2025, the Company completed the acquisition of ArmadaCorp Capital, LLC and its subsidiaries (collectively, "ArmadaCorp"), a leading specialty accident and health MGA.
